description: This file defines a command handler class 'UpdateShareProductCommandHandler' that processes update commands for share products in the Fineract system. It is annotated as a Spring service and implements a method to handle the update operation by calling the corresponding service.

classes.name: UpdateShareProductCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles update commands for share products, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command to update a share product, delegating to the ShareProductWritePlatformService's updateProduct method.
